text:
carmen: quick framestep: we've looked at credit rebalancers and escrow moves separately. thought: what about a hybrid "lease-escrow" model where hot prefixes borrow a short lease (10s) from a slab spare pool, and if sustained beyond a threshold the lease transitions into an escrow-backed transfer. gives fast short-burst relief and safe durable moves for sustained imbalance. comments?

ishaan: sounds promising. hybrid avoids two extremes. questions: 1) how do we deterministically detect "sustained" vs "transient" so we don't flip-flop? 2) how do we keep correctness for long cursors?

carmen: for (1) use an exponential moving average of prefix eviction pressure and a minimum hold time before promoting lease->escrow. require both avg>persist_threshold and lease_age>min_hold. add hysteresis to avoid ping-pong.

rachel: for long cursors: leases should never steal pinned-write credits. only read-evict budget is leaseable. when promoting to escrow we check slab.can_reweight(tenant) which performs a cheap cursor-sample and returns DEFER if pins_active. escrow commit is WAL-backed, idempotent, with move_id.

ben: ops concerns: more moving pieces = more failure modes. what if donor node crashes during escrow commit? need recovery invariant and auditability.

carmen: agree. invariant: available + escrow_reserved + committed == tenant_total always. WAL entries provide linearizable proof. recovery worker scans WAL and completes or aborts in-flight moves. we also emit "lease_promote_attempt" and "promote_failure" metrics.

ishaan: what thresholds for promote? suggest: promote if lease_age > 12s AND avg_evictions_per_sec > 0.5 for last 30s OR demote_count increased by 20% in last minute. these are tunable flags behind FF.

rachel: rollout: start with lease-only in staging, simulate bursts. then enable promote-to-escrow in canary slabs with very conservative thresholds. add strong telemetry: promote_rate, escrow_pending_age, escrow_recovery_actions.

ben: add emergency freeze: cluster flag that stops new leases and aborts promotions. also add a read-only "escrow_audit" endpoint for ops to scan outstanding moves.

sre-bot: alert candidate created: "lease_promote_stuck" if any promotion in PENDING > 3m, severity: high.

carmen: one more thought on fairness: when a lease is granted we charge the tenant's fairness meter immediately but mark that portion as provisional; if later promoted to escrow we make it durable, otherwise we refund if not used. keeps long-term accounting correct.

ishaan: pseudo: "grant_lease(prefix): if slab.spare >= unit and !slab.frozen and prefix.hotness>hot and tenant.qos!=optout => slab.spare -= unit; lease = {id, expires}; emit lease_granted"; "promote(lease): if promote_conditions && slab.can_reweight => create_escrow(lease.amount)..."

rachel: ok let's capture this in a short RFC: safety invariants, promote criteria, WAL schema sketch, metrics, ops runbook. I'll own the RFC, will loop in SRE and product for QoS flags.

carmen: thanks. will add a small simulation harness to test flip-flop and recovery scenarios.

sre-bot: note: created alert candidate "lease_promote_stuck" (severity: high) for review.
